original_question: Let N be a II1 factor with the Haagerup property, and let B be a property-(T) subalgebra of the ultrapower NU. Determine whether there exist finite-dimensional subalgebras M_n subset N such that B is contained in the ultraproduct product n->U M_n.
target_in_paper: Problem 12 in the section "Existential embeddings," introduced by the surrounding sentence as "J. Peterson’s conjecture." ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
correct_elements: Your draft already matches the core content of the paper-faithful problem: a II_1 factor with the Haagerup property, a Property-(T) von Neumann subalgebra inside its ultrapower, and the question whether that subalgebra must lie inside an ultraproduct of finite-dimensional subalgebras of the original factor. That is exactly the structural shape of Problem 12. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
missing_details: The paper adds the hypothesis that the ambient II_1 factor is Connes embeddable; this is not optional in the paper’s wording of Problem 12. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

The ultrapower is the tracial ultrapower N^𝒰, with 𝒰 taken, by the paper’s opening convention, to be a nonprincipal ultrafilter on ℕ. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

The paper asks for finite-dimensional subalgebras of N indexed by n, i.e. a sequence (N_n) with N_n ⊂ N, not just an unspecified family. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

The desired conclusion is the explicit inclusion chain B ⊂ ∏_𝒰 N_n ⊂ N^𝒰; your draft states the first inclusion but not the full ambient inclusion back into the ultrapower. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

To be fully stand-alone, the question should say that B has Property (T) as a von Neumann algebra and that the N_n are finite-dimensional von Neumann subalgebras. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))

The paper does not add separability, factoriality of B, or any broader approximation requirement here, so those should neither be inserted nor inferred. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
refined_question: Let 𝒰 be a nonprincipal ultrafilter on ℕ, and let N be a Connes-embeddable II_1 factor with the Haagerup property. If B ⊂ N^𝒰 is a von Neumann subalgebra with Property (T), must there exist finite-dimensional von Neumann subalgebras N_n ⊂ N such that B ⊂ ∏_𝒰 N_n ⊂ N^𝒰? ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
justification: The draft is targeting the paper’s Problem 12, not a neighboring question. Problem 11 asks whether a II_1 factor with the Haagerup property can existentially contain a Property-(T) factor, and the sentence immediately after that says, "For another interesting conjecture along these lines see J. Peterson’s conjecture, below," after which Problem 12 gives the finite-dimensional-subalgebra containment question in the ultrapower setting. The paper’s opening notation also fixes the meaning of 𝒰 and of the tracial ultrapower notation. There is no explicitly stated equivalent reformulation nearby in the paper, so the best refinement is the direct sharpened restatement of Problem 12 itself. ([ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org](https://ar5iv.labs.arxiv.org/html/2511.20377v2))
